# phron_locations (Data Source)

The Locations a Server can live in, each with whether new Servers can be created there now.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phron_locations" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "locations".
- `locations` (Attributes List) Every Location, offered or not. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether something new can be created there now.
- `country` (String) The country.
- `id` (String) The Location id, as resources take it in `location`.
- `name` (String) The city.
- `unavailable_reason` (String) Why not, when available is false.
